title: Signature QC: The Fresh-Eyes Rule
description: Manon's fresh-eyes rule: the person who made it cannot do final inspection — a second pair of eyes, or the same eyes tomorrow, catches what familiarity hides. 'You cannot proofread your own work' is a universal, and QC ignores it at its peril. The rule is scheduled, not aspirational. Signature original.
